title: Group consolidation
notes: Fictional demo data ($000) shaped like the group: a foundation, a holdings sub-group with development LPs, a housing fund and a partner LP that outside investors part own.
Entity figures, the intercompany register and the intergroup balances stand in for what Home Hub hands over; every elimination and every group's statements are formulas.
Choose the group shown on Group statements; By group holds every group's consolidation month by month.
